name: Siddhant Pathak
eyebrow: 2026 COMPUTER SCIENCE GRADUATE · VELLORE INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY
headline: Android Developer. Java Backend Engineer.
intro: I enjoy building Android products with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, and engineering the Java backends behind reliable applications. Android is where I started; backend engineering with Java and Spring Boot is a passion I keep growing.
about: I'm Siddhant Pathak, a 2026 Computer Science graduate from Vellore Institute of Technology. I build Android applications with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and modern app architecture, and I enjoy designing backend systems with Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security and databases. I independently built and published PaisaPulse Ledger on Google Play and migrated its categorization backend from FastAPI to Spring Boot. I have also built a custom API Gateway and a personal-finance REST API. Outside development, I share project-building lessons, interview preparation and practical career guidance with students through YouTube, Instagram and X.
lifequestDescription: A gamified productivity and self-improvement Android app in development. The planned experience includes daily quests, XP, levels, streaks and progress tracking, built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, with a Java Spring Boot backend planned.
